legal.takedownIntro: If you believe content on this platform is unlawful, defamatory, infringes your copyright or other rights, or contains your personal data, you can submit a takedown request. We will review and respond within {days} days.
legal.takedownGdpr: For GDPR / KVKK data subject requests (erasure, access, rectification), use the Privacy Policy contact instead.
legal.takedownHow1: Fill in the form below with as much detail as possible.
legal.takedownHow2: Provide a public link to a document proving your identity or authority.
legal.takedownHow3: Specify the URL of the content and explain the issue clearly.
legal.takedownNext1: You receive a confirmation email within 24 hours.
legal.takedownNext2: A moderator reviews your request within 7 days.
legal.takedownNext3: If approved, the content is removed or corrected. You are notified.
legal.takedownNext4: If rejected, you receive a written explanation and may appeal.
legal.takedownAbuse: Submitting fraudulent or vexatious takedown requests may result in account suspension and reporting to the relevant authorities.
legal.takedownProofHint: Link to a document verifying your identity
legal.takedownReceivedDesc: We review takedown requests within 7 days. You will receive a response at the email you provided.
legal.privacyWho: ALPAR AI ("we", "us", "our") operates the public-facing platform at alparai.online. We are an intermediary service: we host user-submitted content but we are not the publisher of that content. The legal entity operating the platform will be disclosed in our Imprint page.
legal.privacyCollectAccount: Account data: email, name, avatar, and OAuth provider metadata when you sign in with Google.
legal.privacyCollectSubmissions: Submissions: incidents, suggestions, evidence files, and consents you grant.
legal.privacyCollectTech: Technical data: IP address (hashed), user agent, locale, and access logs for security and rate limiting.
legal.privacyCollectCookies: Cookies: essential session cookies (Supabase) and optional privacy-friendly analytics (Plausible, no cookies set).
legal.privacyNot1: We do not sell your data. Ever.
legal.privacyNot2: We do not run third-party advertising or tracking.
legal.privacyNot3: We do not fingerprint your device.
legal.privacyPii: All incident submissions are scanned by our PII Guardian before publication. Detected personal data (emails, phone numbers, ID numbers, access tokens, credit card numbers, IBANs) is automatically masked. You retain the right to submit a takedown request for any remaining personal data.
legal.privacyRights1: Access the personal data we hold about you.
legal.privacyRights4: Object to processing or request restriction.
legal.privacyRights6: Lodge a complaint with your supervisory authority (KVKK Kurulu in Turkey, or your local DPA in the EU).
legal.privacyContact: To exercise any of these rights, email {email}. We respond within 30 days.
legal.privacyBasis: We process your data on the basis of (a) explicit consent at submission, (b) legitimate interest in operating the platform and preventing abuse, and (c) legal obligation for record-keeping of moderation decisions.
legal.privacyRetentionAccount: Account data: until you delete your account.
legal.privacyRetentionIncidents: Published incidents: kept indefinitely for transparency, with PII masked.
legal.privacyTransfers: Our infrastructure is EU-hosted. If you access the service from outside the EEA, your data may be processed in the EU; we rely on standard contractual clauses (SCCs) for any third-country transfer.
legal.privacyChildren: The platform is not directed to users under 18. By signing up you confirm you are 18+.
legal.privacyChanges: Material changes will be announced at least 14 days in advance via email and a banner on the home page.
legal.privacyPostal: Postal address: published in the Imprint page when the legal entity is registered.
legal.cookieBody: We use essential cookies to run this site. With your consent we also use privacy-friendly analytics (Plausible) to improve the product. No tracking, no third-party ads.

about.missionText: Build a public, independent, verifiable record of how AI systems behave in the real world — so that users, regulators, and developers can make better decisions.
about.intermediaryText: We host community-submitted reports. We are not the publisher of the content. The liability for the accuracy of any submission rests with the user who submitted it — the same model as Trustpilot or sikayetvar.com.
about.voiceText: Every published incident invites an official response from the AI provider. We verify their identity and publish the response alongside the report. Healthy debate over real evidence.
about.openSourceText: ALPAR is licensed under AGPL-3.0. Anyone can audit the code, run an instance, or contribute. We believe trust infrastructure should itself be trustworthy.
